static_traits.name: Chen Shaoyu
static_traits.occupation: General manager of a local grocery store
static_traits.social_status: Have comedy peers to talk to, but have not yet discussed inner self-doubt with them
static_traits.medical_history: No history of psychotherapy or psychological issues; No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, highly cooperative, Positive attitude; often use 'should' statements and tend to compare

basic_info.main_problem: I feel I should already be a Business owner by now, but am only a local grocery store manager, and this thought brings dissatisfaction and inferiority.
basic_info.core_demands: These feelings of dissatisfaction and comparison are affecting my mental health and overall well-being.
growth_experiences: About a year ago I started comparing my career progress with my personal Anticipation, gradually developing dissatisfaction and inferiority; when goals cannot be achieved quickly as per Anticipation, stress rises significantly; the problem is especially persistent on days when Work gets busier or more challenging; I try to prove my worth by setting higher goals and working harder at Work, but the stress only intensifies.

core_beliefs: Only becoming a Business owner counts as success and worth

special_situations.event: Sees success stories of entrepreneurs of the same age or younger
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am not a Business owner by age 18, it means I have failed and fallen behind others
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Sets higher goals and pushes harder at work to prove his own worth
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not as good as them, I have fallen behind

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot achieve career goals quickly, it means I am incompetent or not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Works overtime, pressures himself, raises goals in hopes of achieving faster

special_situations.event: Reviews the gap between career expectations at age 18 and reality
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Must reach goals on the set timetable to count as success, otherwise it is failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Pressure myself, constantly raise Demands, ignore the positive aspects of my current role
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I should be the boss by now

special_situations.event: Becomes aware of his 'manager' identity when interacting with colleagues or leading a team
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am not the boss, others will look down on me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoid talking about my own insecurity, not discuss specific troubles with friends
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They may feel I am not worthy of respect

core_conflict.wish: Long to Gaining recognition and a sense of worth by becoming a Business owner as soon as possible
core_conflict.fear: Fear of being seen as a failure, being compared as inferior to others, and thus being belittled
defense_goal: Control Anxiety by setting higher goals and doubling efforts, maintaining self-worth
Avoid revealing insecurity to friends to reduce the risk of being judged

object_relations.self_representation: A not-good-enough chaser lagging behind others
object_relations.object_representation: Others (especially successful peers/colleagues) are internalized as judges and embodiments of strict standards

manifestations: The current manager role is Self-deprecated as 'not enough', 'just a manager', and the gap with the ideal (becoming a Business owner) is seen as failure
Continuous self-comparison and 'should' statements reinforce the conditional judgment of self-worth
outcomes: Dissatisfaction and Increased feelings of inferiority
Maintaining relationships with colleagues becomes more challenging

Sets excessively high goals and pressures himself to prove his worth
Excessively concerned about whether self meets standards when interacting with others

manifestations: not yet discussed specific troubles with friends, bearing stress and insecurity inward
Handle self-worth Anxiety by working harder at Work rather than seeking outside support
